description: This file defines the class HTMLPurifier_Lexer, which is a core component for lexing (tokenizing) HTML and SGML markup into tokens for purification and processing. It includes methods for parsing entities, tokenizing HTML, handling CDATA, normalizing HTML, and creating lexer instances based on configuration.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_Lexer
classes.description: A base class for lexing SGML/HTML markup into tokens. It provides mechanisms for entity parsing, HTML normalization, and tokenization, with subclasses expected to implement specific lexing strategies.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Factory method to instantiate appropriate lexer implementation based on configuration.

methods.name: parseData
methods.description: Converts special HTML entities to their character equivalents, with optional legacy decoding.

methods.name: tokenizeHTML
methods.description: Abstract method to lex HTML string into tokens; intended to be overridden.

methods.name: normalize
methods.description: Normalizes HTML input by processing entities, encoding, and optional document extraction.

methods.name: extractBody
methods.description: Extracts the body content from an HTML document.
